In the press

I write about what AI is doing to software: to the people who build it, and to the companies that sell it. Three of my essays reached more than four million readers and were picked up by The New York Times, Inc., Futurism, The Register, and Marketplace. This page has the essays, the coverage, quotes you can use, and how to reach me.

The essays behind the coverage

Most stories about my work trace back to one of these three pieces. Each links to the original so you can quote the source.

Jan 20251.3M readers

AI is Creating a Generation of Illiterate Programmers

After twelve years of coding I noticed I had stopped being able to work without an AI assistant. The essay argues that AI tooling is quietly eroding the fundamentals of a whole generation of developers, and what to do about it.

Covered by: NYT Hard Fork, Inc., Futurism, The Register, Marketplace Tech, Hacker News front page, ThePrimeagen, Tech With Tim

Read the essay →
Feb 2025Widely syndicated

New Junior Developers Can’t Actually Code

A follow-up written after dozens of conversations with new developers: the code works, but ask why and you get blank stares. On what struggling through problems used to teach and how to keep learning with AI in the loop.

Covered by: ITPro, Diginomica, Inside Higher Ed, Developpez, ForrestKnight, Code Monkey

Read the essay →
Feb 2026Hacker News front page

AI is Killing B2B SaaS

Why the most profitable business model on Earth is under threat when every customer believes they can vibe-code something better, what the market is already pricing in, and which SaaS companies survive.

Covered by: Startups For the Rest of Us, TechPlanet, Inc42, Hacker News

Read the essay →

Writing a story? Recording an episode?

I'm happy to talk about what AI is doing to junior developers and the craft of programming, vibe coding and the bill it leaves behind, why B2B SaaS is under pressure, and what it's like to build a company as a solo founder in Y Combinator. I'm building PumpGTM, an AI agent that finds buyers and runs outreach for founders.

I reply to press requests within one business day. Based in San Francisco, available on Pacific hours and happy to record remotely.
